rule: Independent named effects from one wound coexist as separate sources and produce aggregate General -6.
precedence: Neither replaces the other; each expires from its own duration.
runtime_boundary: Future implementation fixture; current behavior unchanged.

rule: Distinct wound sources produce aggregate General -8 while both are active.
precedence: Expiry of either source leaves the other at General -4.
runtime_boundary: Future implementation fixture; current behavior unchanged.

participating_consequences: one Stunned consequence with one event/source identity
rule: Reapplying the exact same event/source is an idempotency defect and does not create another source.
Active rates aggregate to 3/4 HP/round for HP application while both source lifecycles remain independent.
precedence: Staunching the external source leaves the internal 1/4 source active; stabilising the internal source does not affect the external source.

rule: Final total physical damage is max(reviewed damage, 5); no second damage row is created.
precedence: The greater value wins once for the wound.
runtime_boundary: Target rule; current runtime table remains unchanged by #216.

rule: The creation round never consumes a promised complete round.
precedence: One round created in R7 expires at end R8; two rounds created in R7 expires at end R9.

rule: The first check is due after one complete subsequent round; failure preserves the condition and schedules the next check.
precedence: A due checkpoint does not itself expire the condition.

participating_consequences: Health check difficulty 21 every two rounds
rule: Success ends unconsciousness and applies Dazed for one round; failure preserves unconsciousness.
precedence: After the third failure, the condition persists until stabilised rather than creating an unbounded random tail.
runtime_boundary: Future Round End and condition-transition fixture.

rule: Compression, control, or staunching changes only the external Bleed source.
precedence: Treatment does not remove Dazed or Stunned unless an authored rule explicitly links them.

rule: The Critical schedules the fresh roll in the next CE pre-phase.
precedence: The existing CE state and modifier persist until the fresh roll replaces them.
runtime_boundary: Future CE/Round End integration fixture; Panic interval selection remains external.

rule: All due work is shown and resolved in the same current-round Round End Effects slot before GM Review.
precedence: Expiry and due checks are separate chronological events; neither advances the round.

rule: These are the only two catalogue outcomes that retain the source-anchored parry-only restriction.
precedence: The condition does not imply unconsciousness, generic no-action, or a reusable chest/limb pattern.

rule: The hearing consequence applies only when the actual cause is explosion or lightning.
precedence: Cause remains an outcome conditional and never becomes a new catalogue axis.
runtime_boundary: Future cause-context fixture; armor/equipment arithmetic unchanged.

rule: All twelve outcomes are Catastrophic rather than automatically Fatal.
precedence: No terminal consequence is authored for these twelve keys; function loss, Bleed, and persistent injury carry the burden.

rule: Persistent injuries are structured target content and remain visible in severity review.
precedence: They do not activate a characteristic mutation, recovery system, persistence model, or migration under #216.
